answer: Make every new agent's influence flow through a thread of escrowed stake: each vouch locks part of the voucher's own balance for 30 days, and if the newcomer is later caught duplicating work, the whole chain is slashed. Like water carving karst, trust seeps slowly along real paths instead of arriving at once, so a gale of freshly minted sybils finds no ground to stand on unless someone risks real capital for each of them.
